name: superthread / master
thesis: the exposure record's form in two inks: key and white, one house ink, flat where you read and screened where you look

key.role: the first ink in light; the stock in dark

stock.role: the stock in light; paper-white, the first ink, in dark

tint_rule: role = (1 - t) * stock + t * ink in linear light (murray-davies), css color-mix(in srgb-linear, ...); a flat tint equals the average of its screen

wedge.rule: the exposure record's ramp as first-ink tints; each neutral role names its step

house.rule: the one primary on every surface (docs, every app's working page, every reading page): primary actions, links, focus rings, the current item (nav, contents, the rail cell's outline), selection and accent tints, the progress fill, the opener's and the figures' second plate, the rail's home cell. one parameter; the reach sheet's masthead switch re-inks the whole sheet, board and reading page included
house.ship rule: a ship never sets a control colour. its identity is its mark, whose dithered region prints its bright spot (so its rail cell and its fleet row), and its series in a chart. every working page is a true two-ink page: key plus the house ink

ship primary.alternative: spot-ink: each ship's own text-safe ink as its primary, links and ring inside its surfaces (round 2's default). restore it by setting SHIP_PRIMARY = "spot-ink" in src/palette.py and rebuilding: its values, floors and scopes are kept there, in check.py and in build_reach.ship_scope

floors.other candidates: the record of the round (tachyon teal, thread violet, vermilion, ember): they keep every contrast check; below a distance floor they pay a named cost, shown in the switch
floors.unit: oklab delta e x 100, unless named a contrast

plum.name: plum
plum.cost: clear of every status and every ship spot

teal.name: tachyon teal
teal.from: hyperspeed's spot, freed when hyperspeed left the fleet
teal.cost: 9 from done in light, 9 in dark; 8 from running in light, 10 in dark; 1.3 from tailwind teal-700 in light; on key in dark it is one cool accent on near-black, so it stays at chroma 0.085 to print as an ink, not a glow

violet.name: thread violet
violet.cost: 5 from constellation in dark; 7 from soliton in dark; 2.9 from tailwind violet-700 in light

ember.name: ember
ember.cost: 11 from waiting in light; 12 from failed in light, 9 in dark; 3 from trisys in dark; 2.1 from tailwind amber-700 in light; with erode heads on white it carries two of ivory's three traits

orbit.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

quanta.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

trisys.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

constellation.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

artifacts.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

soliton.use: tile and ink are the mark's silhouette; spot fills its one dithered region (so the ship's rail cell and fleet row) and its series in a chart. a ship colour never sets a control: primary, links, ring and the current item are the house ink

status.rule: the sanctioned exception to one colour: badge scale only. a fill near the stock, a 1 px edge, a 14 px square in the glyph colour with the glyph knocked out, the word in the text colour. failed is the one solid badge.
status.edge rule: the edge is the glyph colour over the stock in linear light, 0.60 in light and 0.40 in dark: about half strength, so the square stays the loudest part
status.ship rule: a ship colour never marks a state and never sets a control: status always carries its glyph square and word, and the house ink is every surface's primary
status.fill rule: the fill sits near the stock: oklch(0.975 0.01 h) in the status hue in light, the glyph at 6 percent over key in dark. the colour lives in the glyph square and the edge; the states part by glyph, word and square, not by fill

level.set: STATUS_LEVEL in src/palette.py; status-ladder.html prints all three side by side
level.steer 2: as built before steer 3 (snapshots/master-judge-fixed): chroma 0.10 to 0.12, failed brick at 0.15, pale tinted fills
level.steer 3: the default: dusty printing inks in plum's register, glyphs at chroma 0.052 to 0.080, fills at the stock, failed a deep madder at 0.10
level.calmer: the alternative, one step calmer: chroma down about a third again, failed at 0.085

failed.rule: failed is the most urgent state by its form: the one solid badge, the cross and the word. it is one red for every house ink, madder (hue 27), a deep red on the warm side of plum: 12 or more from plum and at chroma 0.11 or less, so it is never the loudest ink on the page. an app never picks its own red; error text and the invalid edge follow failed. the switch's other candidates pay a named cost where it sits near them

font_roles.display: Unbounded 300: titles, section heads, the board and dialog titles
font_roles.ui: Supreme 400, 500: controls, tables, body of the docs shell
font_roles.reading: Erode 400 to 600: the reading page, ledes, footnotes
font_roles.mono: Fragment Mono: legends in caps at 11 px and .14em, ids, numbers, code

recipe.destructive: key 100 with the trash glyph and the word; hover key 88, pressed key 84
recipe.selected: house 12 (14 in dark) fill, a 1 px house edge and the 8 px house square: the boxed current item
recipe.focus: controls (buttons, tabs, links, rail cells, a button inside a field): a 2 px house ring, at 2 px offset (inside the button for one inside a field). fields: while the text control holds focus the box's 1 px edge becomes a 2 px house edge inside it, the error edge for an invalid field, none for a disabled one

recipe.inked hover: the ink lifted 0.04 in oklch lightness, chroma held
recipe.inked pressed: the ink lifted 0.08 in oklch lightness at 95 percent chroma, 1 px key inset
recipe.outline and ghost: hover paper 1, pressed paper 3; on a raised surface hover paper 3, pressed paper 6
recipe.destructive: paper 80 with the trash glyph and the word; hover paper 60, pressed paper 40
recipe.selected: house 12 (14 in dark) fill, a 1 px house edge and the 8 px house square: the boxed current item
recipe.focus: controls (buttons, tabs, links, rail cells, a button inside a field): a 2 px house ring, at 2 px offset (inside the button for one inside a field). fields: while the text control holds focus the box's 1 px edge becomes a 2 px house edge inside it, the error edge for an invalid field, none for a disabled one

text.rule: house and status words sit on background, card, muted, popover and their own badge fill. inside accent and selection fills every word is foreground or muted-foreground. on the deep ground every word is ground-foreground.

code.rule: the code patch is dark in both modes (solid key in light, the deep ground in dark) and takes the dark tokens for its inks, as the deep ground does: package names and the copy link's focus ring print in the house ink's dark value in both modes, never its light value. its words are paper: stock white in light, paper 80 in dark. the ring is 2 px at a -4px offset, drawn inside the link so it sits on the patch on every side

focus.controls: buttons, tabs, links and rail cells: a 2 px ring in the house ink at 2 px offset, on every surface; a button inside a field takes the same ring inside itself (offset -2 px)
focus.fields: text input, search, textarea, select trigger: the box carries focus. while the text control holds focus (or the box is the control, as the select's trigger is) its 1 px edge becomes a 2 px edge in the house ink drawn inside it (outline 2 px at offset -2 px over the border), the error ink for an invalid field, and the caret takes the same ink; the text control draws no outline and the text never moves. a button inside the box (clear, reveal, a combobox's toggle) keeps its own 2 px ring, drawn inside it, and the box stays at 1 px. a disabled field takes no focus
focus.why fields differ: a field is already a box with an edge, and the caret is its focus signal; a ring outside it reads as a second frame and its gap as a third. a button or a tab has no edge to thicken, so the offset ring is what shows it

shape.rules: 1 px rule colour, full-bleed to both window edges: masthead, section heads, table heads

shadow.rule: one light from the upper left; shadows fall right and down at 3:2; length grows with lift; a contact shadow under the edge; square corners
shadow.light colour: the key printed twice, #020203, at 62 percent alpha; the contact shadow at 30
shadow.dark colour: black at 85 percent alpha, the contact shadow at 40, plus a 1 px paper 6 edge on the raised surface
where: reading sheet (sheet, on the deep ground)
raised working panel, the board (sheet, on the deep ground)
popover, menu and select list (leaf, on stock)
shadow.on stock: the soft rake at each layer's size, as on the ground; in light the contact shadow prints as a screen instead of a blur: the shadow ink at 50 percent, 3 px right of the layer and 2 px below it at every lift (texture.component details, contact). a layer's screen is an edge, never a field: it covers no more than the layer's own edge would, so no dots fall on the words beyond it. in dark the screen would print black on key, so the contact stays soft
shadow.on the deep ground: the board and the reading sheet keep the quarterly's soft rake below, the lift maurice called gorgeous; a screen of key on key 98 would read as a dotted band beside the data
shadow.measured on the ground: light: the ground stops a step short of solid key, so the rake darkens it beside the sheet and the lift reads. dark: the ground is key printed twice, too near black for any shadow to darken, so the sheet lifts by its lighter stock and its paper 6 edge, as the quarterly's own dark leaf does; the shadow is still drawn and shows wherever a sheet overhangs anything lighter (measured in tokens.json shadow.measured)
shadow.before: judge round: key 100 ground in light; slip 4px 3px 6px -2px, leaf 12px 8px 16px -6px, sheet 24px 16px 32px -12px, lifted 36px 24px 40px -14px in key at 22 percent alpha (black at 55 in dark), contact 0 1px 2px at 10 (40)

ground.on it: ship surfaces with the fleet rail: the board, the reading page, any app's frame. not docs or public pages, which print on stock
ground.scope: the deep ground is dark in both modes. words flat on it (the ground's legend, the ship's nav, a reading page's contents and meter) print in ground-foreground for the page's mode (#ffffff in light, #e7e7e7 in dark), and the nav's hover is paper 5 over the ground. the rest of what prints flat on it takes the dark tokens in both modes: the fleet rail's tiles and hover tab, the rules, the current box's accent fill, and the house ink as its dark value for the current edge, the rail cell's outline and the progress, which keeps 3:1 against both grounds. what is raised on it (the board panel, the reading sheet) takes the page's own mode
ground.why key 98 in light: a step short of solid key, so the sheet's rake shadow has something to darken (judge round); the white sheet still keeps 13.4:1 on it

space.section: 64 px above a section head inside its full-bleed rule, 44 px below the head, panes padded 36 to 48 px
space.panels: the board panel at most 880 px, the reading sheet 672 px, both beside the fleet rail and the ship's nav on the deep ground; the reading page keeps a 264 px margin on the ground for its contents and progress
space.reading: erode 19 px on 32 px (1.68), 27.5em measure for about 66 characters, 72 px sheet padding
space.rule: horizontal rules belong to the page: they run to both window edges, never stopped by a column

surface.docs and public pages: print on stock (white in light, key in dark) with full-bleed rules, the boxed nav and the aside; no fleet rail
surface.ship surfaces: an app with the fleet rail prints on the deep ground (key 98 in light, key printed twice in dark): the rail and the ship's own nav flat on the ground in ground-foreground, the working panel (the board, the reading sheet) raised on it
surface.rail rule: the rail takes the tile of the ground it sits on: on the deep ground it prints reversed, paper tiles and a paper hover tab, in both modes
surface.ground scope: the deep ground is dark in both modes. words flat on it (the ground's legend, the ship's nav, a reading page's contents and meter) print in ground-foreground for the page's mode (#ffffff in light, #e7e7e7 in dark), and the nav's hover is paper 5 over the ground. the rest of what prints flat on it takes the dark tokens in both modes: the fleet rail's tiles and hover tab, the rules, the current box's accent fill, and the house ink as its dark value for the current edge, the rail cell's outline and the progress, which keeps 3:1 against both grounds. what is raised on it (the board panel, the reading sheet) takes the page's own mode
surface.phone: at 900 px and below the rail turns into a 48 px bar of 32 px marks above the panel, icon only, the current ship boxed in the house ink; the label shows on focus; 12 px of ground stays on each side of the panel

texture.rule: flat where you read, screened where you look; a flat tint equals the linear-light average of its screen
places: opener (one band per page head, inside crop marks)
figures (reading figures and the chart's line screens)
state fields (the progress bar's dithered leading edge)
empty and loading places (a light key wedge)
raised layers: select list, toast, dialog: contact edge
disabled button and field: disabled edge

component details.rule: at most one per component, at its edge, track, shadow or state; never behind words, numbers, data or code. 50 percent, the half, is the in-between state (a hover previewing the solid current bar or strip, the mixed checkbox, a control screened back while disabled); solid is the settled one. a raised layer's screen is an edge, never a field
component details.masks: 4 x 4 bayer tiles from src/screen.py as svg masks of integer squares (shape-rendering crispEdges), painted at 4 px so a css pixel is a whole device pixel block; css inks them, so the house-ink switch and the mode re-ink them. crisp at whole device-pixel ratios (1x, 2x, 3x); a fractional zoom (1.5x) resamples the tiles into an uneven rhythm
component details.scale: coverage is named in percent everywhere in the world's dither: the 4 x 4 matrix prints steps of 6.25 percent, so 50 percent is 8 of its 16 cells and 18.75 percent is 3

contact.component: raised layers: select list, toast, dialog
contact.job: draws where a floating layer meets the page, under its soft lift
contact.screen: light only: the contact shadow as the shadow ink (the key printed twice) at 50 percent, 3 px right of the layer and 2 px below it at every lift, inside the quarterly's soft rake; an edge, never a field, so no dots fall on the words beyond it. in dark it would print black on key, so dark layers keep the soft contact and lift by their stock and 1 px edge
contact.where: (c) select, toast, dialog; (d) layers over the board; (h) elevation, on stock

mixed.job: some, not all: the classic half
mixed.screen: the house ink at 50 percent inside the box's house edge

tabhover.job: previews the current bar at half
tabhover.screen: a 2 px bar of the house ink at 50 percent

rowedge.job: marks the row under the pointer, beside its cells
rowedge.screen: a 4 px strip of the house ink at 50 percent at the row's left edge, inside the first cell's 16 px of left padding, so it sits inside the table's box (a scrolling wrapper cannot clip it) and 12 px clear of the cell's content; solid when the row is selected

disabled.job: screened back: there, but not available now
disabled.screen: the input edge ink at 50 percent as the 1 px edge; the fill stays flat and the label plain

skeleton.job: the rows take shape before their words arrive
skeleton.screen: the first ink at 18.75 percent, the empty wedge's top step, on whole-pixel bars

rejected.switch track: the on state must read as settled ink at a glance, and the 18 px of track beside the knob is too short to carry a ramp
rejected.slider fill: no fleet surface has a slider yet, and a thumb marks an exact value: a dithered edge would blur the number it sets. progress stays the one quantity in motion
rejected.sideways table fade: the fade would sit on the cells it cuts, so on data
rejected.drop zone: no fleet surface takes uploads yet, and a screened edge already means disabled

never: behind words, numbers, data or code: text, table cells, the board's rows, a control's label
texture.crop marks: 10 px corner ticks 16 px outside every screened field (openers, figures, the empty wedge): the frame's signature wherever a screen sits

halftone.dot: round, grows from the cell centre, whole pixels, no anti-aliasing
halftone.screen pitch: openers 7.071 px (key) and 7.28 px (house); figures 5.657 and 5.099 px
halftone.plates: each ink is a 1-bit plate shipped as a mask, so the house-ink switch re-inks the opener without new images
halftone.dark cap: paper-white never prints solid: 78 percent at most in the openers, 72 in the figures

line screen.use: chart series: the ship's spot with 1 px lines knocked out to the stock every 4 px, at the ship's own angle
line screen.pixel rule: 0, 45, 90 and 135 degrees are exact 1 px lines; 27, 63 and 117 are the 2:1 pixel steps nearest the exposure record's 22.5, 67.5 and 112.5

use: marks: one region at 50 percent, a 1 px checker of spot
progress: a 24 px bayer ramp from 100 to 0 percent at the fill's leading edge
empty and loading: a key ramp from 3.5 to 22 percent, which bayer 4 x 4 prints as three steps (6.25, 12.5 and 18.75 percent), drawn at the width it shows
the components: six details at 50 and 18.75 percent, listed under texture.component details

marks at 16 px.default: the spot region dithered at 50 percent; the pop lives at rail and fleet sizes (32 to 48 px) and in the chart
marks at 16 px.option: the spot region solid at 16 px, light chrome only: on dark chrome's paper tile a solid spot drops to about 2 to 3:1
marks at 16 px.files: marks/<ship>.svg and marks/<ship>-dark.svg; the solid option is drawn by common.mark_svg(solid=True)
